violations.text: Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of biofilm debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice machine taken out of service, ice disposed. Maintenance contacted for cleaning and sanitizing this evening. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/01/2026

The door to the outside, located at the main exterior entrance), is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 10/15/2026
Mops must be allowed to air dry after use. PIC rinsed and hung mop to dry. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2025
